title: Japan’s Toyota Builds a City-like Center to Test Robotics, AI
titleZh: 日本丰田打造“类城市”中心 测试机器人与人工智能
credits: The Associated Press reported this story. Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Japanese automaker Toyota says it is building a research center in a city-like setting to test robotics, artificial intelligence (AI) and autonomous vehicle technologies.
sentences.zh: 日本汽车制造商丰田表示，它正在一个类似城市的环境中建设一个研究中心，用于测试机器人技术、人工智能（AI）和自动驾驶技术。

sentences.en: Toyota recently announced it had completed the first part, or phase, of the center, called Woven City.
sentences.zh: 丰田最近宣布，它已经完成了该中心的第一阶段，即“织都”（Woven City）。

sentences.en: It sits near the southern Japanese city of Susono.
sentences.zh: 它位于日本南部城市静冈县御殿场市附近。

sentences.en: Company officials recently showed off the latest progress to reporters from the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 公司官员最近向美联社记者展示了最新进展。

sentences.en: Daisuke Toyoda is an executive for Toyota who is helping lead the project.
sentences.zh: 丰田高管丰田大辅正在帮助领导这一项目。

sentences.en: He told the AP that the center was not designed to be a “smart city.”
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社，该中心并非被设计成一个“智慧城市”。

sentences.en: However, it aims to carry out technology research and development and be “a test course for mobility.”
sentences.zh: 然而，它的目标进行技术研发，并成为“出行的测试场”。

sentences.en: The company said Woven City would serve as a “Living Laboratory.”
sentences.zh: 公司表示，“织都”将作为一个“生活实验室”。

sentences.en: It aims to test technology systems to support future changes in “the movement of people, goods, information and energy.”
sentences.zh: 它的目标是测试技术系统，以支持“人、货物、信息和能源”流动的未来变革。

sentences.en: Toyoda said the center is meant to be a place where researchers and technology company officials can come together and share ideas.
sentences.zh: 丰田说，这个中心旨在成为一个让研究人员和科技公司官员聚集在一起、分享想法的地方。

sentences.en: It will also seek to establish a community with a shared desire “to co-create, develop and refine” new technology products and services.
sentences.zh: 它还将努力建立一个拥有共同愿望的社区，以“共同创造、开发和完善”新的技术产品和服务。

sentences.en: Woven City was built on the grounds of a closed Toyota automobile factory.
sentences.zh: “织都”建在一个关闭的丰田汽车工厂的场地上。

sentences.en: The automaker said the project’s first phase covers about 47,000 square meters.
sentences.zh: 这家汽车制造商表示，该项目的第一阶段覆盖了约4.7万平方米。

sentences.en: When completed, it will spread out over 294,000 square meters.
sentences.zh: 完工后，它将扩展到29.4万平方米。

sentences.en: Building operations on Woven City began in 2021.
sentences.zh: “织都”的建设工作于2021年开始。

sentences.en: All the buildings are connected by underground passageways.
sentences.zh: 所有建筑都由地下通道连接。

sentences.en: Among planned testing activities will include self-driving vehicles making waste pickups and completing deliveries around the area.
sentences.zh: 计划中的测试活动将包括自动驾驶车辆在周边区域进行垃圾清运和完成配送。

sentences.en: Testing operations will center on how people living in cities can best interact with changing technologies.
sentences.zh: 测试操作将集中于城市中的人们如何最好地与不断变化的技术进行互动。

sentences.en: Currently, no one lives in Woven City.
sentences.zh: 目前，还没有人住在“织都”。

sentences.en: When it opens, officials plan on having about 100 people living there.
sentences.zh: 开放时，官员们计划在大约100人居住在那里。

sentences.en: They will be called “weavers.”
sentences.zh: 他们将被称作“织工”。

sentences.en: These are workers employed by Toyota and its partner companies making other products.
sentences.zh: 这些是由丰田及其合作公司雇用的、从事其他产品生产的工人。

sentences.en: When AP reporters visited the area, Japanese coffee maker UCC was serving hot drinks from a self-driving bus.
sentences.zh: 当美联社记者探访该地区时，日本咖啡制造商UCC正从一辆自动驾驶巴士上供应热饮。

sentences.en: The bus was parked in an area surrounded by still-empty housing.
sentences.zh: 这辆巴士停放在一片仍空无一人的住宅区周围。

sentences.en: Toyota has supported electric vehicle (EV) technology in the past.
sentences.zh: 丰田过去一直支持电动汽车（EV）技术。

sentences.en: However, the company is currently involved in a push for hydrogen, the energy of choice in Woven City.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前该公司正致力于推广氢能源，而这正是“编织之城”所青睐的能源。

sentences.en: Keisuke Konishi is an automobile expert at Japan’s Quick Corporate Valuation Research Center.
sentences.zh: 小西敬介是日本Quick企业估值研究中心的汽车专家。

sentences.en: He told the AP Toyota has plans to expand into self-driving vehicle services to compete with Google’s Waymo and other large companies.
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社，丰田有计划拓展自动驾驶车辆业务，以与谷歌的Waymo及其他大公司竞争。

sentences.en: Konishi noted the company has the money for such development even if it means building up a completely new business.
sentences.zh: 小西指出，即使这意味着要建立一个全新的业务，该公司也有资金进行这样的开发。

sentences.en: “Toyota has the money to do all that,” he said.
sentences.zh: “丰田有资金去做这一切，”他说。

sentences.en: Toyota officials have said they do not expect Woven City to make money, at least not for the first few years.
sentences.zh: 丰田官员曾表示，他们不指望“编织之城”能赚钱，至少头几年不会。

sentences.en: Several other futuristic developments have been planned in other areas of the world over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，世界上其他地区还规划了其他几个未来主义开发项目。

sentences.en: They have included efforts in Toronto, Canada; Saudi Arabia; Abu Dhabi; and San Francisco, California.
sentences.zh: 其中包括在加拿大多伦多、沙特阿拉伯、阿布扎比以及加州旧金山所作出的努力。

sentences.en: But those projects are either still being developed or have been canceled.
sentences.zh: 但这些项目要么仍在开发中，要么已被取消。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩·林恩。
